bib.title: ViLT: Vision-and-Language Transformer Without Convolution or Region Supervision
bib.venue: Proceedings of the 38th International Conference on Machine Learning, PMLR 139, 2021

read.skipped: References skimmed only; no appendix in the cached text.

question: Can a vision-and-language model embed images with a plain linear patch projection (no CNN, no region detector) and still match region/grid-feature VLP models at far lower cost?
hypothesis: The transformer used for modality interaction can also process visual features in place of a convolutional visual embedder, just as it processes textual features.
contributions: ViLT is the simplest architecture by far for a vision-and-language model as it commissions the transformer module to extract and process visual features in place of a separate deep visual embedder.
For the first time, competent performance on vision-and-language tasks without region features or deep convolutional visual embedders.
For the first time, empirically show that whole word masking and image augmentations further drive downstream performance.

method.summary: Single-stream transformer initialised from ViT-B/32. Image is cut into 32x32 patches, linearly projected, concatenated with BERT-tokenised text embeddings plus modal-type embeddings. Pre-trained with ITM (+ word patch alignment) and whole-word MLM on 4 caption datasets, then fine-tuned on VQAv2, NLVR2 and retrieval.
method.task: vision-and-language pre-training; VQA, NLVR2, image-text retrieval

datasets.name: Google Conceptual Captions
datasets.source: Sharma et al. 2018; only urls provided, images from urls still accessible

datasets.name: SBU Captions
datasets.source: Ordonez et al. 2011; urls still accessible

datasets.name: VQAv2
datasets.split: train+val for fine-tuning, 1,000 val images and their questions held out for internal validation; test-dev via server

datasets.name: NLVR2
datasets.preprocessing: pair method: two (question,image) pairs, concatenated pooled outputs

datasets.name: MSCOCO and Flickr30K retrieval
datasets.split: Karpathy & Fei-Fei 2015 split; F30K 1K test, COCO 5K test
datasets.preprocessing: 15 random negative texts sampled per positive

models.name: ViLT-B/32
models.architecture: single-stream pre-norm ViT-style transformer encoder over concatenated text+patch tokens
models.init_from: ViT-B/32 pre-trained on ImageNet-21K, fine-tuned on ImageNet-1K; text embeddings (t_class, T, T_pos) learned from scratch, not from BERT
models.context: max 200 image patches sampled in pre-training (240 max for 384x640) + text

other.image_resize: shorter edge 384, longer edge < 640, aspect ratio preserved

models.name: Region/grid VLP baselines
models.architecture: ViLBERT, VisualBERT, LXMERT, UNITER-Base, OSCAR-Base, VinVL-Base, Unicoder-VL, ImageBERT, Pixel-BERT-X152/R50

training.objective: ITM (aligned image replaced by another with p=0.5, NLL) + 0.1 x word patch alignment (IPOT, beta=0.5, N=50 iterations) + MLM with whole word masking, p=0.15
training.seq_len: up to 200 patches sampled in pre-training; up to 240 in fine-tuning
training.regularisation: RandAugment (N=2, M=9) at fine-tuning, without color inversion and cutout
training.seeds: classification tasks: 3 fine-tuning runs (head init seed and data order), mean reported; retrieval: single run

other.retrieval_loss: cross-entropy over 1 positive + 15 sampled negatives, head initialised from ITM true-pair logits
other.MPP_ablation: masked patch prediction p=0.15 predicting mean RGB; did not help

other.latency_hardware: Xeon E5-2650 CPU and NVIDIA P40 GPU

metrics.name: VQA score
metrics.definition: inferred answer compared to 10 ground-truth answers, test-dev

metrics.name: R@K
metrics.definition: whether ground truth is in top K results

eval.protocol: Classification: mean of 3 seeds, std in Table 5. Retrieval: one fine-tune. Zero-shot and fine-tuned retrieval.

results.claim: Linear patch embedding takes about 0.4 ms of the pipeline, versus ~810 ms for region operations plus ~75 ms backbone in region-feature models.

limits: ViLT-B/32 is described as a proof of concept; falls short on VQAv2 and COCO image retrieval versus heavy visual embedders (authors suspect detector objects ease VQA).
Weights from ViT-B/32 (ImageNet-21K) only; larger data (JFT-300M) and larger variants (ViLT-L/H) left for future work.
Masked patch prediction failed; no good visual masking objective without region supervision.
Initialising from BERT plus ViT patch projection 'did not work' (footnote 4, no numbers).
Pre-training stopped at 200K steps because fine-tuned text retrieval decreased afterward.
Hyperparameters not tuned per task; retrieval fine-tuned once only; precision, compute hours not stated.
Speed numbers are for 2021 hardware (CPU Xeon E5-2650 + P40); superseded by later models (e.g. CLIP, ViT-based VLMs).

masks all consecutive subword tokens that compose a whole word
